prompt:
A full-fidelity desktop website design comp, 16:9 landscape, showing the top of the page at 1440 px wide, rendered edge to edge as the page itself (no browser window around the page, no device). The website for PrismTTY, a live terminal-output highlighter for network engineers, executed as a best-in-class dark developer-tool landing page at Linear's level of craft, but with a bolder centered composition than the usual split hero. Near-black ground (#0a0b0d), text #f2f3f5, secondary #8b9099, hairlines #23252a, one refined sans for type and a clean monospace for code.

Behind the top half of the page, full bleed: a big cinematic video frame, real photographic footage: in a pitch-black room a single thin beam of white light enters a clear glass prism from the left and leaves it as a soft, physically real spectrum fanning to the right, shot macro with shallow depth of field, deep shadows, low saturation, film grain, no neon, no glow effects. The footage is darkened so text on it reads cleanly.

Regions:
1. Top navigation over the footage: at left a small prism-triangle logo mark (an outlined triangle with a tiny terminal window inside) and the wordmark "PrismTTY"; at right the links "Profiles", "Install", "Docs", "GitHub".
2. Centered over the footage: a large tight headline "Readable output, live in your terminal." and one centered lede line "One wrapped shell colors SSH, console, pipe and log output, and follows you from device to device." Under it, centered, an install chip "$ brew install inxbit/tap/prismtty" with a copy icon, and a ghost button "View on GitHub".
3. The focal element, overlapping the bottom of the footage and running below it: a very large terminal window about 80 percent of the page width, title bar "ptty /bin/zsh" with a small profile stack indicator "linux-unix  >  cisco" at right. Inside, a real multi-hop session: "ops@workstation % ssh admin@edge-sw1.example.net" in plain light text, then "edge-sw1#show interfaces description" and rows "Gi1/0/1  up  up  Uplink to core-rtr", "Gi1/0/2  down  down  Spare access port", "Po10  up  up  Bundle to dist-a", then "edge-sw1#show ip route" and "O  192.0.2.0/24 [110/20] via 198.51.100.1, 00:00:14, Vlan1191". Highlighting exactly like real PrismTTY: prompts pure white, interface names bright blue #0099ff, every "up" pure green #00ff00, "down" bold pure red #ff0000, IP addresses cyan #00ffff. These saturated terminal colors are the only strong color on the page apart from the footage.
4. At the bottom edge, the first line of the next section: a small label "How it works" and the start of a heading.

Calm, premium, cinematic, precise spacing. No gradient blobs, no neon. Real readable text at real size, about 16 px body on a 1440 px page.
